issues.description: Method signature inconsistency for `addGuestStudents`: the problem statement/UML and solution define `addGuestStudents(int)` (single int parameter), but the template provides a stub `addGuestStudents(int, boolean)` with an extra `boolean validateInput` parameter. This mismatch can block students because implementing the required API will not match the starter code signature and may not compile against the intended tests.
issues.suggestedFix: In the template `Lecture.java`, change the stub to match the specified API: replace `public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, boolean validateInput)` with `public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents)` and remove the unused validation parameter/comment (perform any validation internally if desired).
